headline: After Hormuz, Red Sea Also Breached…Houthi Attack on Cargo Ship Kills 3
summary: Houthi rebels attacked a small cargo ship in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, reportedly killing three crew members. The incident comes amid a Middle East conflict triggered by US and Israeli attacks on Iran.
why: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait links the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and is a key route for global oil and container shipping. Attacks there can raise shipping risk and freight costs.
why_moved: The attack is reported to have killed three crew members on a cargo ship in a key Red Sea chokepoint, amid an ongoing Middle East conflict.
